key_insight: Frozen medical LLM embeddings can act as a shared representation for combining structured EHR variables and discharge notes to predict primary ICD category.
clinical_relevance: This suggests a lightweight way to improve diagnosis coding support and cross-dataset adaptation without retraining a full model.
method: Built a MIMIC-IV cohort of 13,645 admissions from 10 common primary ICD-10 codes grouped into 7 categories
Serialized structured EHR variables into narrative text and combined them with leakage-pruned discharge notes
Extracted hidden states from a frozen MedFound-Llama3-8B backbone and trained linear probes across layers, with XGBoost and PLM-ICD baselines for comparison
evidence_signal: On MIMIC-IV, the combined probe achieved 87.69% strict accuracy and 91.45% medical accuracy, and a small adapter enabled transfer to MIMIC-III using 5% of target labels.
watch_item: Performance depends on careful leakage control and may not generalize beyond the tested ICD subset, datasets, or probing setup.
paper_title: Primary ICD Category Prediction using LLM-based Probing
